summary: Production implementation plan for the DARK ESCAPE Real-Time 4K-Ready 2.5D Graphics Engine: procedural PBR-styled bitmap material & mipmap cache, real-time dynamic point-light & ambient occlusion renderer, ULTRA/HIGH/PERFORMANCE adaptive quality tiers with live FPS/frame-time profiler, cinematic boss & pinch/dynamic zoom camera, destructible & animated biome props across all 8 biomes, and full state-driven character/enemy animations.
